# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

Hiring Team  
Planit  
Sydney, NSW, Australia  

**Re: Application for Automation Tester (Playwright & TypeScript)**

Dear Hiring Team at Planit,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Automation Tester role at Planit. With over 19 years of quality engineering and test automation experience—highlighted by hands-on delivery using Playwright, TypeScript, CI/CD pipelines, and AI-assisted tooling—I am eager to contribute to Planit’s reputation as a global leader in quality engineering and consultancy.

In my current role as Senior Quality Engineer at Wpay (Woolworths Group), I developed a complete end-to-end test automation suite using Playwright for critical activation and redemption workflows. My hands-on technical background includes building reusable test frameworks, executing UI and API test suites, and automating API Gateway regression testing integrated directly into Azure DevOps pipelines. Furthermore, during my tenure as QA Lead at Avant Mutual, I directed cross-functional release management, daily defect triage, and end-to-end quality strategies through complex enterprise modernizations, ensuring robust data integrity and system quality.

Planit’s emphasis on innovative, AI-assisted automation practices directly matches my recent technical focus. As a Google Cloud Generative AI certified engineer, I have designed custom GitHub Copilot SKILLs for automated script generation, established automated pull request (PR) review workflows, and validated AI-generated automation code to eliminate breaking changes and elevate test coverage. 

Based in Sydney, I am well-positioned to fulfill your hybrid working arrangements and collaborate effectively across technical delivery teams. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my automation framework expertise and quality leadership can support Planit and its clients.

Sincerely,

Anoop Sinkaran
